summary: All 6 acceptance criteria pass. The duel HUD unification correctly extends ExpeditionHud with optional duel instruments (VersusInstrument, RaceProgressInstrument) that only render when the duel prop is provided. Solo climb has no regression. Connection status priority logic is correct (own reconnecting suppresses opponent stale). Countdown overlay matches solo climb pattern structurally. Quality gates green: typecheck clean, lint 0 warnings, 688/688 tests (31 new). No critical or blocking issues.
goal: Validate duel HUD unification against spec acceptance criteria AC-1 through AC-6

exitCriteria.AC-1: PASS — shared instruments render identically in duel mode (2 tests)
exitCriteria.AC-2: PASS — duel instruments conditional on duel prop; solo never renders them (2 tests + call-site review)
exitCriteria.AC-3: PASS — VersusInstrument shows names + LIVE badge; RaceProgressInstrument shows race bars (11 tests)
exitCriteria.AC-4: PASS — opponentStale=true during climb shows 'opponent reconnecting...' (4 tests)
exitCriteria.AC-5: PASS — connectionState disconnected/suspended/connecting shows 'reconnecting...' with correct priority (5 tests)
exitCriteria.AC-6: PASS — countdown uses same Overlay pattern as solo climb (structural comparison)
exitCriteria.NFR-3: PASS — quality gates green (688/688 tests, lint 0 warnings)
exitCriteria.F-1_flow: PASS — duel match flow end-to-end validated
exitCriteria.F-2_flow: PASS — solo climb regression guard, no duel instruments leak

learnings.insight: All 6 ACs pass with 31 new tests covering the duel HUD instruments. Quality gates green (688/688). The change is a pure client-side UI refactor with zero new API surface, no new dependencies, and no security findings. Ready for integration.

The countdown overlay in both DuelRoom.tsx and ClimbScene.tsx Overlay lacks aria-live='assertive' for screen reader announcement of 3-2-1 numerals. This is a pre-existing gap (both paths share it) and not introduced by this change. A future accessibility pass should add aria-live='assertive' aria-atomic='true' to the countdown container in both locations, or extract a shared GameCountdownOverlay component.
learnings.action: Track as a follow-up accessibility improvement covering both duel and solo countdown paths.

learnings.insight: DuelHudInfo.phase and DuelHudInfo.connectionState are typed as 'string'. VersusInstrument checks specific literals ('climb', 'disconnected', 'suspended', 'connecting') but TypeScript cannot verify exhaustiveness. Narrowing to MatchPhase and a connection state union would catch typos at compile time.
learnings.action: Consider narrowing these types in a follow-up to get exhaustiveness checking.

learnings.insight: The duel HUD unification is structurally sound. Connection status priority (own reconnecting suppresses opponent stale) is correct and well-tested. Boundary values (zero maxAlt, empty racers, long names, single racer) are covered. No regressions in solo climb path.
